Subject: Vendor onboarding: Saffron Supply — PO assignment and spend caps

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding path. Attached is our completed onboarding form (saffron_onboarding_form.pdf). A couple of urgent items we discovered while preparing the invoice schedule:

- We don’t yet have a PO number assigned on Redwood’s side for our initial activation period. The accounting team needs one (or two) PO values to map invoices.
- Our SKU list includes a bundled line that needs to be split for monthly billing vs. one-time setup fees — right now the line shows as a single item (SKU-SS-BUNDLE) in the form.
- Current internal budget: Saffron expects to draw ~USD 120,000 in month 1 across both billing streams; if possible we also want to request a temporary uplift during ramp.

Can you confirm next steps and who on your side will issue PO numbers and the spend cap table? I’ve copied Carlos (finance) and our procurement alias.

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Head of Operations
Saffron Supply
Attachment: saffron_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Saffron Supply — PO assignment and spend caps

Hi Elena — good to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the form. A few quick notes and the plan: 

- We can provision two PO numbers to map the two billing streams (monthly consumption + one-time setup). I’ve looped Marcus (procurement ops) and Irene (finance) to assign serial PO numbers and confirm spend caps.
- Marcus, can you reserve PO(s) and indicate any restrictions we should surface to Saffron?
- Irene, if Saffron needs a provisional uplift for month 1, outline what information you need to approve a temporary increase and any billing holds.

Elena — please send the detailed SKU-to-line mapping (or the CSV) if you have one; Marcus prefers to ingest a CSV so he can produce the PO assignment CSV back to you.

Next step: internal PO assignment and then we’ll return the PO CSV + updated onboarding form.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Monica / Irene — I’ve provisionally reserved two PO serials and mapped the SKU lines as requested. See summary below and attached CSV for the full mapping.

Assigned PO(s):
- PO-45321: Monthly consumption (recurring charge) — maps to SKU-SS-MONTH and split-out SKU-SS-API_USAGE
- PO-45322: One-time setup & professional services — maps to SKU-SS-SETUP and the legacy bundled SKU (split into two lines: setup + initial credits)

Line item corrections applied:
- Line 3 (original SKU-SS-BUNDLE) was split into SKU-SS-SETUP (one-time) and SKU-SS-CREDIT (one-off credits).
- Billing code for SKU-SS-API_USAGE corrected from BC-17 to BC-21 per Elena’s form.

Conditions / notes:
- Both POs created as provisional (status: PROV) until finance confirms spend cap.
- I’ve set a default spend ceiling of USD 120,000 across PO-45321 for month 1 and USD 15,000 on PO-45322 for one-time items. If Saffron requests an uplift we’ll need a short approval note from finance.

Attachments: PO-45321-assignment.csv (csv), PO-45322-amendment.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Marcus — that mapping looks good and the split on the bundled line is exactly what we need. Two quick asks before we finalize: 

1) Temporary spend cap uplift: for launch-phase usage we estimate up to USD 180,000 this month (higher than the 120k default). Can you escalate a provisional increase for PO-45321 while finance reviews? I’ve attached a brief spend-forecast.
2) Billing code mismatch: line 2 in PO-45321 still reflects BC-17 in the assignment CSV — our accounting flagged BC-29 as the correct vendor billing code for that SKU. Can you confirm and patch?

Attachment: spendcap-change-request.xlsx (xlsx)

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we’re aiming to go live on Nov 10 and need the final PO mapping + SOW signed before then.

Best,
Elena
